limits.symbol-key: a property read or defined with a symbol key
limits.builtin-property: the properties of the builtin functions other than their `length`, `name` and static members, and the prototype objects (`String.prototype`, and `__proto__` read from a primitive)
limits.native-call: a builtin function outside callAllowed that a builtin calls, whose result veslint does not model (`JSON.stringify`, `Array.from`…): a callback of `every`, `filter`, `find`, `findIndex` or `some`, the `join` that `Array.prototype.toString` calls, the `toString` or `valueOf` of an object converted to a primitive (where the methods that convert their receiver are not called either)
limits.bigint-size: a BigInt of more than 2^16 bits made by `**` or `<<` (V8 goes up to 2^30)
limits.long-value: a string of more than 2^20 units made by `padStart`, `padEnd` or `String.raw`, or an array-like object of more than 2^20 elements as the receiver of an array method
limits.depth: an expression or a chain of constants more than 100 levels deep
